title: Provider Credential Not Accepted (400)
description: Closed 400 problem document returned when a configuration request carries a provider credential (or is too large to scan for one). Provider credentials are never accepted by the API: configure them in the deployment environment or secret storage. Fixed code and text; nothing from the request is echoed. The same body applies to every configuration operation that the intake guard covers; this repository declares it first on agent import. The request id travels only in the `X-Request-ID` response header.
